lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance white spots arranged in approximate vertical columns in the posterior section, transitioning to a dense, less-ordered distribution in the anterior region near the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible in the mid-flank, intersecting with several high-luminance blobs to create a loose grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible across the upper-third of the flank, characterized by a distinct light-to-dark pixel intensity gradient from its dorsal to ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A clear U-shaped or semi-circular mark is visible in the center of the lateral flank, interrupting the standard distribution of high-luminance blobs.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, elongated high-luminance objects (commensal fish) visible beneath the pectoral fin area.
